definition: axis_a_identity (content_hash, case_number, judgment_date, court, case_title > 3 chars)
AND >= 1 CANONICAL_ACCEPT claim in a court-authored role (holding | reasoning | reasoning_proposition | proposition)
AND >= 1 CANONICAL_ACCEPT claim in an outcome role (relief | relief_granted | court_action)
AND 0 ROLE_MISMATCH claims anywhere on the document
